title: Characterize writable bridge cleanup when a result's final native encoding fails after acquiring its writer
reason: Reviewed non-promoting characterization/design; excluded from the 461 assertion-bearing case credit; source retained.

contract.intent: Characterize writable bridge cleanup when a result's final native encoding fails after acquiring its writer
contract.preconditions: COMMON; fresh owned fixture required; peer retains writable origin for lock/abort observation
trace: request writable followed by Symbol in result
poll peer origin lock and abort count
contract.stress: One writable with zero writes and at most 100 settlement checks at 10ms intervals
contract.oracle: Origin becomes unlocked and abort count exactly 1; leaked writer blocks cleanup and is never called a pass
contract.cleanup: Shared cleanup aborts only an unlocked writable; locked origin reports CLEANUP_BLOCKED; always owned fixture teardown
